candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 5 ether, which alters whether fallback call succeeds and thus changes observable state.
Invert the timestamp comparison to require block.timestamp < pastBlockTime, changing when the fallback updates pastBlockTime and potentially reverting calls.
Remove the update to pastBlockTime (delete assignment), so fallback no longer changes that state variable.
Always transfer only 1 wei to msg.sender when block.number % 15 == 0 instead of the full contract balance, changing observable transfers.
Insert a revert when block.number % 15 == 0, causing calls that would previously transfer to instead revert and thus changing observed outcome.
